evals.prompt: find-features just listed auth, billing, and search as undocumented. Please go document all three.
evals.expected_output: Skill verifies prerequisites, takes the three named features, inventories docs/features/ to confirm none are already documented, dispatches one subagent per feature in a single message (so they run in parallel), then writes docs/features/auth.md, docs/features/billing.md, docs/features/search.md from the template, and appends three entries to docs/FEATURES.md (alphabetical). Leaves TODO markers where content cannot be derived from the code. Does not commit.

evals.prompt: document every undocumented feature in this repo
evals.expected_output: Skill parses 'every' as 'all', identifies undocumented feature areas with meaningful implementation, dispatches subagents in parallel batches capped at 10 per batch, writes one doc per feature, and updates docs/FEATURES.md. If there are more than 10 features, runs a second batch after the first finishes. Reports back which features were skipped and why.

Skill treats 'billing' as a single named feature, checks docs/features/billing.md does not already exist, locates billing in the codebase, dispatches one subagent to document it, writes docs/features/billing.md from the template, and adds an entry to docs/FEATURES.md. If billing already has a doc or cannot be located, the skill surfaces that instead of silently creating something.

Skill parses '5' as a numeric limit, identifies undocumented feature areas, ranks by significance, takes the top 5, dispatches 5 subagents in parallel in a single message, writes 5 docs from the template, and updates docs/FEATURES.md with 5 alphabetical entries. Other candidates are listed in the final report as 'not selected this round'.
